entries.reason: Fixed registry slots and mutation events use a typed Protobuf contract while open-ended metadata uses Protobuf Struct.
entries.schema: policyregistry:registry, version 2, with generation-qualified slots, typed descriptors and ordered mutation events.
entries.version: Version 2 is written; version 1 JSON is accepted only for migration, and later versions are rejected.
entries.migration: Legacy version 1 JSON is decoded into a detached registry image; new writes use Protobuf binary or Protobuf JSON.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary unknown fields are rejected recursively; Protobuf JSON rejects unknown names. Open metadata keys are carried by google.protobuf.Struct.
entries.restore_atomicity: All slots and events are validated in a detached VersionedRegistry State; restoreState publishes once and emits no per-item callbacks.

entries.reason: The registry exposes typed Protobuf persistence beside its existing policy query, event and script surfaces.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this change.

entries.thread_affinity: All registry mutation and persistence calls run on the owning thread; observer callbacks run after commit.
cost_notes: Binary and JSON snapshots cost linear time in retained slots, events and metadata bytes per save or restore operation.
